title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Application for Remittance)
(1) A person who intends to remit money by international money order shall submit an International Money Order Payment Certification and Remittance Request (hereinafter referred to as a "remittance request") to the remitting post office together with the remittance amount and the international money order handling fee.
(2) The addresses and names of the remitter and payee entered in the remittance request shall be written using Roman letters and Arabic numerals. <Amended on April 30, 2007>
(3) Where a remittance request and attached documents are prepared and submitted in a foreign language other than English, a Korean or English translation prepared or certified by a state agency or authorized institution of the country using that foreign language may be required to be attached.
(4) After entering the remittance details into the computer system based on the remittance request, the remitting post office shall issue an international money order receipt to the remitter.
